lines.text: The ruler of Tyre claims to be a god, is wiser than Daniel, and gained wealth by trading.
God says He will bring the most ruthless of nations, who will bring the ruler down to the Pit.
God tells Ezekiel to lament for the king of Tyre, who was in Eden, adorned with precious stones.
The king was blameless until wickedness was found, so God cast him into the desert and made fire consume him.
God tells Ezekiel to prophesy against Sidon, then will gather Israel into the land given to Moses.
